lead: Targeted round on test build 0.8.33 (CI run 40119192061) after the first 0.8.33 round passed: only the changes since then. New: TI Revive reads only the 64-bit Virus Control.dll (E345) and the Windows setup / Linux install.sh replace a 32-bit one; the MSI's last page tells updaters to keep the Access .msi at hand; on the Mac old Virus A/B/C library patches get the right default page B (E346). Mark each item, add a note where something looks different, then copy the results at the bottom into the chat.
rules: Order: Linux first (the Virus is on this PC), then the Windows VM, then the Mac. Close the DAW before the Virus moves.

sections.title: Linux
prep: Claude installs the CI build with install.sh and runs hil.sh (cold start, reopen, export) before this block.

items.title: install.sh again keeps the 64-bit Access files
steps: Claude ran ./install.sh of the CI build over the existing setup (output in the chat).
items.expect: No 'replacing' line for Virus Control.dll; the installed DLL is still the 64-bit one (a622f9a2..).

items.title: Old Virus C library loads with names
steps: REAPER, TI Revive: LOAD > Personal Libraries > Manuel Schleis > Manuel Schleis Incubation V2.
Load two or three of its patches into part 1 and play them.
items.expect: 128 names in the list; the patches load and play.

sections.title: Windows 11 (VM)
sections.where: win11 VM, Ableton Live 11; the VM still has the 32-bit Virus Control.dll from an older TI Revive setup
prep: Claude copies the CI build's TI-Revive-0.8.33-setup.exe into the VM's Downloads, next to the Access .msi, and attaches the Virus.

items.title: Update: the finish page and the 64-bit DLL
steps: In the VM, double-click TI-Revive-0.8.33-setup.exe in Downloads and click through.
On the last page read the new text above the checkbox; keep the box checked and click Finish; confirm the admin prompt.
items.expect: The text is fully readable (not cut off) and the checkbox is not covered; a message says the Access files are set up; Claude then finds the 64-bit DLL (a622f9a2..) in Common.

items.title: Plug-in opens after the update
steps: Start Live 11, load TI Revive Virus Control on a MIDI track, play a few notes.
LOAD > Personal Libraries: open an old Virus A/B/C library if one is there (else skip that part).
items.expect: The editor opens and plays; an old library shows its names.

sections.title: macOS
prep: Claude pushes the CI package to the Mac (INSTALL-COMMAND.txt and 'Install test build.command' in the unpacked folder); you run the installer, then hil-mac.command.

items.title: hil-mac on the new build
steps: Run hil-mac.command from the unpacked folder's hil folder (about 5 minutes) and send the result folder.

items.title: Virus C patch with the right page B
steps: Live 12, TI Revive: LOAD > Personal Libraries > Manuel Schleis > Manuel Schleis Incubation V2 (Claude copies it to the Mac's Documents/Access Music/Virus TI/Patches) and load its first patch into part 1.
Note one page B setting of it (for example the second effect's type or the mod matrix slot 4 destination) and tell it in the note; Claude compares it with Linux.
items.expect: The patch loads and plays; the page B setting matches the same patch on Linux.
